respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture diagram illustrates two main workflows: Data Ingestion and Data Retrieval. In Data Ingestion, raw CSV/gz data files arrive in Amazon S3, triggering an AWS Lambda function for validation, which outputs to a validated S3 bucket. A second Lambda processes and ingests this data into an AWS OpenSearch cluster powered by Graviton2. In Data Retrieval, users interact via web (through a frontend application) or mobile to reach a backend application, which queries the data layer (Amazon OpenSearch and Amazon RDS), generates reports stored in Amazon S3, and sends user notifications via Amazon SES. Graviton2 hardware labels were merged into the OpenSearch nodes as configuration notes.
respuesta.nombre: Data Ingestion and Retrieval Architecture with AWS OpenSearch
